meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: The weighted average lending rate on banks' outstanding loans, as on 31 March each year 1992 to 2014, by sector, size of loan and type of loan (discontinued)
meta.note: RBI, Weighted Average Lending Rate (Discontinued) (DBIE report 755), from the annual BSR-1 return; as on 31 March (dated on the March). A separate ruler from the monthly WALR series that began in 2012: different coverage and method, never joined.
